column1: # Release titles and what each profile must do with them; tests/scores checks
# every row. Columns, tab-separated: kind, service, profile, title.
#   block        the score is below the profile's minimum: never grabbed
#   allow        the score reaches the minimum: grabbable
#   ladder:NAME  rows sharing NAME, service and profile score strictly
#                lower in the order listed — best first
# Titles are realistic shapes, not real releases; each varies one feature.
# ── Radarr: what the hardware cannot play ──────────────────────────────────
# ── Radarr: audio, flat across both profiles ───────────────────────────────
# ── Radarr: HDR in UHD — DV with fallback over HDR10+ over HDR10 over SDR ──
# ── Radarr: release groups — Bluray tiers above WEB tiers above the rest ───
# ── Radarr: HD x265 with no HDR gets in only with DD+ ──────────────────────
# ── Sonarr: what the hardware cannot play ──────────────────────────────────
# ── Sonarr: HD x265 with no HDR gets in with DD or better ──────────────────
